Jedná se o zorganizované dovednosti do řádků, kde na každém dalším řádku jsou

dovednosti obtížnější. Znamená to tedy, že jak uživatel postupuje kurzem dále, tak tím budou

je současný systém jazykového stromu odlišný, protože ten starší měl přesně dané dovednosti,

které musel uživatel splnit pro postup dále.

_Obrázek 11 Ukázky starého (vlevo) a současného (vpravo) jazykového stromu [Zdroj: vlastní úprava, Duolingo]_

**Lišta zdatnosti**

Lišta slouží k měření správných odpovědí u lekcí. Lišta se postupně naplňuje

Streaks. A streak represents the number of days in a row that a learner has used Duolingo, and appears as a flame icon in the app. Each day a learner gains XP, their streak gets one day longer. Streaks are a powerful motivator to keep learners coming back every day.

Gems. Gems are the Duolingo virtual currency, which rewards learners for accomplishments like leveling up a Skill. This currency allows learners to buy virtual items from our “Shop,” including a “Streak Freeze,” which maintains a learner’s streak even if they miss a day of practice.





Leaderboards. Leaderboards are weekly cohorts of 30 learners who compete to earn the most XP. Leaderboards are organized into Leagues based on the volume of XP earned, starting with the Bronze league, and ending with the Diamond league for the highest XP earners. Each week, the top 10 learners in each Leaderboard advance to the next League. Learners can track their Leaderboard progress daily and are motivated to accumulate XP to earn a place in the top 10.

results.title: Duolingo Learning Path UX Redesign
results.summary:
Duolingo's Learning Path Is Charming On The Surface, But A Cluttered Sidebar And Accessibility Gaps Are Quietly Undermining The Experience.
...
The right sidebar stacks at least three high-contrast promotional cards (Super upsell, feature unlock, quests) plus an ad-blocker notice simultaneously, forcing learners to process competing calls-to-action before they can focus on the one thing that matters: hitting 'CONTINUE.' The Saasfactor AI Component Density benchmark shows top-performing SaaS screens average just 6 buttons total, and Psychology of Design's Hick's Law confirms that every additional option measurably slows decision-making. Compounding this, the 'JUMP TO SECTION 3' button uses near-white text on a white background, a pattern flagged in the Saasfactor AI Accessibility Analysis where 19% of contrast failures involve disabled states that look interactive. Meanwhile, the top stats bar (streak, gems, hearts, flag) relies entirely on icons with no text labels, violating WCAG 2.2 criterion 1.1.1, a violation category found in 45% of icon-only button instances across the Saasfactor AI trained dataset.
...
New learners arriving at the home screen face decision paralysis before completing a single lesson, and screen reader users receive zero context for the four core stats that track their progress. Korean beginners are also shown untranslated native-script speech bubbles they cannot yet read, creating a Gulf of Evaluation identified in Don't Make Me Think's First Law: pages should be self-evident without requiring decoding.
What We Changed
• Sidebar: Reduced to one visible promotional card at a time using a carousel, ensuring the main 'CONTINUE' CTA holds the highest visual weight on the page
• Locked button: Restyled with a clear disabled treatment (grayed fill, lock icon, tooltip reading 'Complete Section 2 to unlock') bringing contrast to WCAG 2.2 AA standard of 4.5:1
• Stats bar: Added aria-labels and hover tooltips ('Streak: 2 days', 'Gems: 410') with abbreviated visible labels on desktop
• Speech bubbles: Added small English subtitle translations beneath Korean text to support comprehension without removing target-language exposure
• Progress bar: Labeled '0 / 30 lessons' with a trophy tooltip explaining the section reward, reducing cognitive load per Psychology of Design principle 4
...
A calmer, more focused learning path that respects the learner's attention, meets WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility standards, and keeps the product's signature playfulness intact while removing the friction that was competing with it.
